503.description: Necessary DB/config unavailable; safe health fields only. Provider failure with functioning core fallback returns READY/DEGRADED 200.

SessionAuth.name: sessionid
SessionAuth.description: Django session; anonymous routes explicitly override security. Mutations also require CSRF.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque owner/filter-bound cursor; stable ascending (created_at,id), no offset.

Csrf.name: X-CSRFToken
Csrf.description: Get token using auth/csrf/; cookie/token match required on every mutation, including login/register. Session rotates at login.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Owner + operation + key scopes a receipt >=7 days. Same digest replays persisted status/body/operation; different digest returns 409. Permanent domain uniqueness survives expiry.

400.description: Malformed/schema/limit error; never strong misconception evidence.

401.description: Authentication required, independent of object existence.

403.description: CSRF failed or forbidden role; no owner-secret details.

404.description: Missing OR foreign owned object: identical generic response.

409.description: Revision, version, idempotency or state conflict.

503.description: Operation cannot safely finish; reconcile canonical state before retry.
